article.title: NATO’s Rutte Downplays ‘Tit for Tat’ Response to Russia
article.summary: NATO chief Mark Rutte said Tuesday that the alliance will not always respond “tit-for-tat” to Russian hybrid attacks despite having “the response options we need.” The statement came amid heightened Russian activity in and around Europe, including frequent drone incursions and border-crossing incidents, with Rutte’s recent remark that Article 5 should remain “deliberately ambiguous,” raising questions about how, and if, NATO will respond if things come to a head.

article.title: Russia ordered an arson attack on Estonian defence company Milrem Robotics
article.summary: Russia’s intelligence services ordered an arson attack on premises used by Milrem Robotics in Tallinn, Estonia’s domestic security agency has concluded.The fire, which broke out in the early hours of 15 August, was the first Russian-sponsored attack in Estonia this year to evade the authorities and be successfully carried out, according to Margo Palloson, the director-general of the Estonian Internal Security Service, known as Kapo.The Estonian foreign ministry said it would summon Russia’s chargé d’affaires over the attack.“Today we can say with complete certainty that the arson attack on Milrem was an act of sabotage commissioned by the intelligence services of the Russian Federation,” the Estonian prime minister, Kristen Michal, said.Continue reading Russia ordered an arson attack on Estonian defence company Milrem Robotics at Estonian World.
